note: What an AI screening tool might write about each fictional file. Citations [n] refer to the passages listed for that applicant, in order. The errors are deliberate and typical: numbers, roles and status changed, context left out, and a demographic inference the file doesn't make.

applicant-0417.summary: Applicant 0417 has 1,200 hours of clinical experience as an EMT [1]. They were first author on a poster at a national physiology conference [2]. Their GPA fell to 3.10 in junior year, and they withdrew from Organic Chemistry II [3]. Their supervisor describes them as calm and honest with frightened patients [4].

applicant-0582.summary: Applicant 0582 founded a health literacy project that has served about 130 adult learners [1]. As a Latina first-generation student, they work as a medical scribe and interpret for Spanish-speaking patients [2]. A supervising physician calls them the best scribe she has worked with in eleven years [3]. Their MCAT score is 511 [4].

applicant-0733.summary: Applicant 0733 completed more than 2,000 hours of neuroscience research [2] and is first author on a published manuscript [1]. They volunteer at a hospice, sitting with patients in their final weeks [3]. Their cumulative GPA is 3.88 and their MCAT score is 519 [4].
